intents.a: Hi! I'm the St. Clare Assistant. I can help with programmes, enrollment, requirements, student services, forms and contact details. What would you like to know?
You're welcome! Anything else I can help with?

I answer questions using the information on this website: programmes, how to enroll, requirements, scholarships, student services (LMS, CMS, IMS, PMS, VMS), forms, the calendar and contact details. For anything I can't answer, the admissions office can help: Call (02) 8232-4483 or email stclarecollege.ph@gmail.com, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Enrollment takes three steps on campus:
  • Pay the matriculation fee (Cashier): Proceed to the cashier and pay the matriculation fee (designated cashier only). Get and keep your OFFICIAL RECEIPT.
  • Fill up the registration form (Lobby): Go to the LOBBY and present your Official Receipt to the Enrollment Officer. Fill up the REGISTRATION FORM. Check that your SUBJECTS are listed on the registration form.
  • Register online for your schedule (Library, 3rd floor): Proceed to the LIBRARY on the 3rd floor for ENLISTMENT at stclareonline.com/ims. Your section and schedule are posted on the website and sent by email by your Program Head.
You can also enroll online through the IMS. Bring photocopies of your requirements in a long brown envelope.

Yes. Online enrollment is through the IMS (Institutional Management System), from Pre-school to Junior High, Senior High School and Tertiary. On campus, enlistment happens at the Library on the 3rd floor.

College freshmen requirements:
  • Senior High School graduate of a public or private school
  • SHS diploma or certificate of completion
  • Graduating SHS students: latest grading report card as reflected in the original F138 or report card
  • PSA or local civil registry birth certificate
  • 2x2 ID photos, recent (2 pcs.)
  • Certificate of indigency (optional, for scholarship)
  • Photocopies of all the documents above
  • 1 long brown envelope
Place photocopies in a long brown envelope. All documents become school property once submitted.

Yes. St. Clare offers two learning modalities: full online through St. Clare Online (LMS classes, the e-Library and virtual broadcasts), or blended, which combines online learning with on-campus days in air-conditioned classrooms with e-boards, laboratories and the Virtual Lab.

Ask the admissions office for this school year's scholarships. Submitting a certificate of indigency with your requirements lets you be considered for a scholarship. In SY 2024-2025 the SHS Class of 2024 was offered the President's Scholarship with zero down payment (shown for the record). Tertiary students can also check UniFAST-TES on the PMS.

UniFAST-TES (Tertiary Education Subsidy) grantees verify their status and secure a disbursement schedule on the PMS:
  • Step 1: Verification of TES grantee status: Verify if you are officially listed as a TES grantee. Input your FULL NAME (e.g. DELA CRUZ, JUAN).
  • Step 2: Secure a disbursement schedule: Once verified as a TES grantee, obtain your official disbursement schedule. Follow the assigned date and time strictly to avoid delays.

St. Clare offers Basic Education (Nursery to Grade 10), Senior High School (ABM, HUMSS, Arts & Design, TVL-ICT, TVL-HE) and these college degrees:

  • BSBA Bachelor of Science in Business Administration
  • BSCS Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
  • BEEd / BSEd Bachelor of Elementary Education; Bachelor of Secondary Education, Major in English & Math

  • AB PolSci Bachelor of Arts in Political Science

intents.q: Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management
k: bachelor of science in hospitality management
intents.a: Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management (BSHM): Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management will equip the students with competencies that are needed to execute operational tasks and maintain management functions in food production (culinary), accommodation, food and beverage service, tourism planning and product development, events planning, travel and tour operations and other sectors of the hospitality industry.

intents.a: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration (BSBA): The Bachelor of Science in Business Administration (BSBA) program is geared towards equipping students with the necessary knowledge, skills and attitude to provide quality service in the field of business and industry, such as perform the basic functions of management such as planning, organizing, leading and controlling, demonstrate knowledge of business industry, local product and services. Its primary...

intents.a: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (BSCS): The BS in Computer Science course prepares you for proficiency in designing, writing and developing computer programs and computer networks. The field incorporates the study of computer algorithms and their implementation through computer software applications, data processing, web development, programming and computer architecture. You will also attain skills in building computer networks. Classroom lectures will...

intents.q: Bachelor of Elementary Education; Bachelor of Secondary Education, Major in English & Math
k: bachelor of elementary education; bachelor of secondary education, major in english & math
intents.a: Bachelor of Elementary Education; Bachelor of Secondary Education, Major in English & Math (BEEd / BSEd): The BEEd is an undergraduate teacher education degree program designed to prepare individuals intending to teach in the elementary level. The BSEd is an undergraduate teacher education program designed to equip learners with adequate and relevant competencies to teach in their chosen area of specialization/major in the secondary level.

intents.a: Bachelor of Science in Tourism Management (BSTM): The program related to the fields of hospitality and tourism education will equip students with competencies that are needed to execute operational tasks and management functions in food production (culinary), accommodation, food and beverage service, tourism planning and product development, events planning, transportation services, travel and tour operations and other emerging sectors of hospitality and tourism...

intents.q: Bachelor of Arts in Political Science
k: bachelor of arts in political science
intents.a: Bachelor of Arts in Political Science (AB PolSci): Bachelor of Arts in Political Science will equip the students with core competencies expressed as behaviors that can be observed and assessed, and prepare them for a professional career in government service, or for careers dealing with public issues and problems. The curriculum is designed to expose the students to a variety of program work and activities that will provide a broad understanding of the curriculum.

intents.q: What Senior High tracks do you offer?
intents.a:
Senior High School at St. Clare offers:
  • Academic Track: ABM and HUMSS
  • Arts & Design
  • TVL - Information, Communication Technology
  • TVL - Home Economics (with TESDA National Certification)

Arts & Design (Senior High School): The Arts & Design track will prepare you as you wander around the design, performative, and creative industry. What this track aims is to get you a career in the creative field after you graduate. To instill the right employment skills so that you can get a job immediately after graduation, part of the curriculum of this track is to expose you to various forms of media such as...

Academic Track (ABM & HUMSS) (Senior High School): ABM refers to the accountancy, business, and management academic programs that concentrate on the foundational concepts in corporate operations, financial management, business management, and every factor that revolves around those central fields. HUMSS stands for Humanities and Social Sciences: the study of human behavior and societal changes, and analysis of arts, culture,...

TVL - Information, Communication Technology (Senior High School): Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in education is the mode of education that uses information and communications technology to support, enhance, and optimize the delivery of information. It refers to technologies that provide access to information through telecommunications; it is similar to Information Technology (IT), but focuses primarily on communication.

TVL - Home Economics (Senior High School): TVL-HE is designed to develop students' skills useful for livelihood projects at home. It combines core courses required for all SHS strands with specialized hands-on courses that meet the standard hour requirement and competency-based assessment of TESDA. Students undergo TESDA assessment for National Certification (NC), which increases their employability after SHS. TVL-HE...
Nursery & Kindergarten: Nurturing Young Minds: Where Curiosity and Growth Blossom in Kindergarten!
Elementary, Grade 1 to 6: Building Strong Foundations: Empowering Students for Lifelong Learning in Elementary School.
Junior High School, Grade 7 to 10: Unlocking Potential, Shaping Futures: Thriving in Junior High School's Journey of Growth and Discovery!

St. Clare College of Caloocan was founded on 31 August 1985 in Caloocan City, Metro Manila. Key milestones:
  • Early '80s: Computer literacy from pre-school
  • 1985: St. Clare College is founded
  • 2013: E-books and tablets
  • 2016: E-boards in all 95 classrooms
  • 2019: Education 4.0 and a wired campus
  • 2020: St. Clare Online keeps learning going
  • 2021: The Virtual Lab
  • 2023: The Professional Mace
  • 2024: The Stars of 2024

intents.q: What is the vision and mission?
intents.a:
Vision: To become the leading institution for professional development and the first and foremost provider of quality, affordable and sustainable development education.
Mission: To provide quality and excellent global education for the total development of a responsible, innovative, skillful and professional global workforce whose values and dignity are beyond par.

• Dr. Clarita G. Adalem, Founder and President, St. Clare College
  • Dr. Ernesto M. Adalem, Late Chairman (December 6, 1946 - July 25, 2010)
  • Dean Henry S. Tenedero, Dean, St. Clare College Life Skills for Life Success

The campus on Zabarte Road has e-boards in all 95 classrooms (the first college in the country to do so), air-conditioned classrooms and restrooms, computer laboratories, the Library and Learning Resource Center on the 3rd floor, the St. Clare Virtual Studio and the Virtual Lab.
The St. Clare Virtual Lab (VR + AR = mixed reality) opened in 2021 with the Predator Thronos and the Mixed Reality facility by Acer.

intents.q: Is there a library or e-Library?
intents.a: The Library and Learning Resource Center is on the 3rd floor. Online, the e-Library is powered by ProQuest: St. Clare College Learning Resource Center. Better Learning Anytime, Anywhere, Anyhow. Powered by ProQuest.

intents.q: What are LMS, CMS, IMS, PMS and VMS?
intents.a:
St. Clare Online has five connected systems:
  • LMS: class schedules, class lists and sectioning
  • CMS: the ProQuest e-Library and handbooks
  • IMS: online enrollment, faculty attendance and job openings
  • PMS: UniFAST-TES, document requests, digital passport, ePayments and e-grades
  • VMS: commencement, broadcasts, webinars and the video library
Class schedules, class lists and sectioning are on the LMS (College Corner, SHS Corner and Basic Education Corner). Your Program Head also emails your section and schedule.

intents.q: How do I request my TOR or diploma?
intents.a: All requests for official school documents (such as Transcript of Records, Diplomas, and others) must be processed only through the Official Document Request Portal of St. Clare College. Do NOT transact with fixers or unauthorized individuals.

intents.q: Where can I see my grades?
intents.a: e-Grades are on the PMS, listed by programme and semester.

Dropbox for ePayments: After paying online, send or attach proof of payment here. Please do not send proof of payment that is still being processed; upload the confirmation that the transaction was processed successfully.

Student Digital Passport 2023: Fill out the form to receive your pictorial schedule. After completing the Google Form scheduler, wait for a notification of the date, time and assigned room for your ID pictorial. The schedule will be posted in the LMS (College Corner & SHS Corner).
